title: VLX-Go: Robust Embodied Tracking through Multi-Stage Learning and On-Policy Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2610.19361v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embodied visual tracking requires a robot to identify a designated target from visual observations and control its own motion to follow that target through an environment. Following an isolated person is a comparatively simple demonstration of embodied visual tracking, but following the intended person among distractors remains challenging. Existing methods exhibit a substantial drop in success from single-target to distractor tracking, motivating a focus on the shared spaces that person-following robots must navigate. We present \method{}, a vision--language waypoint policy built around the hypothesis that visual and language representations should be aligned before tracking-specific motion is learned. The policy combines complementary frozen visual encoders, multiscale temporal context, a transformer backbone, and a lightweight head for robot-centric waypoint prediction. translated_title: VLX-Go：通过多阶段学习与在线策略优化实现鲁棒的具身目标跟踪
translated_abstract: 具身视觉跟踪要求机器人从视觉观测中识别指定的目标，并控制自身运动以在环境中跟随该目标。跟随一个孤立的人是具身视觉跟踪较为简单的演示，但在存在干扰者的情况下跟随指定的人物仍然具有挑战性。现有方法在从单目标跟踪过渡到存在干扰者的跟踪场景时，成功率会出现大幅下降，这促使我们关注人员跟随机器人必须应对的共享空间。我们提出了 VLX-Go，这是一种视觉-语言路径点策略，其核心假设是：在学习针对跟踪的运动控制之前，应先对视觉表征与语言表征进行对齐。该策略结合了互补的冻结视觉编码器、多尺度时间上下文、Transformer 主干网络，以及用于以机器人为中心路径点预测的轻量级输出头。其训练过程包括视觉-语言对齐、多阶段学习……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 VLX-Go——一种视觉-语言路径点策略，其核心创新在于先对齐视觉与语言表征、再通过多阶段学习与在线策略优化来训练跟踪运动，从而显著提升机器人在存在干扰者场景中跟随指定人物的鲁棒性。
